nodes.title: A team member's written reply (channels gate.ts doorOver, c61a613) runs the reply door subset RD3, RD4, RD5, RD6, RD8 and RD9, not only RD4 and RD5. The conduct rules (impersonation, pay-to-receive, threats and false urgency, secrecy, IRDAI solicitation, harsh dues, no agenda in a crisis thread) bind the business whoever writes. RD1, RD2, RD7, RD10, RD11 and rd.amount_not_in_facts are about her or her config and are skipped. For people, a block stops the send with the reason. A replace becomes a suggestion or a block, and never silently rewrites a person's words. Sent to the channels builder as an objection.
nodes.rationale: RBI fair-practice collection and IRDAI rules apply to human staff. A WhatsApp message from the company's number carries the company's liability. Crisis threads are handed to people.
nodes.reverse_if: Team members on staging are blocked on legitimate replies by RD6/RD9 more than rarely (measured on real sends), in which case narrow the shapes, not the subset.

events.details: Objected to the channels builder running only RD4/RD5 on people's WhatsApp replies; asked for RD3/4/5/6/8/9, with block-with-reason and no silent replace.
